questions.question: How should the Great Library make God Questions visible, composable, continuously updated, and connected to evidence, decisions, approved action, and capability learning without becoming the corpus warehouse or execution runtime?
questions.next_useful_work: Independently replay the repaired privacy and authority gates, then close the bounded v1 with immutable Library lineage while keeping GQ-009 researching.
questions.decision_to_change: Which registry fields, Library projections, evidence interfaces, and action-return contracts should become the standard infrastructure for every SISO God Question?
success_criteria: A cold human or agent can find every standing question, its state, decision target, evidence gaps, falsifiers, watch triggers, and current answer lineage from one generated Library surface.
Existing repositories, books, videos, research, and operational receipts can attach to a question through owned evidence systems without being copied into the public registry.
A question can justify a bounded action candidate and later receive a verified learning return without the Library authorizing or executing the action.
At least one repeated mechanism discovered through a question can be evaluated and promoted into its independently owned capability Work.
falsifiers: The design requires a second question registry or central operational database to remain coherent.
The visible dossier accumulates metadata but cannot improve a real research, routing, or investment decision.
Useful evidence cannot be connected without leaking private corpora, machine paths, client data, or operational topology into the public Library.
Maintaining the question contract costs more attention than the repeated research and decision errors it prevents.
evidence_gaps: No evaluated end-to-end user flow yet proves that the portfolio view helps a cold operator choose the next valuable investigation.
Claim, contradiction, assumption, experiment, mandate, observation, and learning-return objects do not yet share one proven cross-system receipt contract.
No three-question cohort yet measures authoring overhead, evidence reuse, decision impact, or capability promotion rate.
watch_triggers: A new God Question cannot express a decision target, falsifier, evidence gap, or refresh condition in the current contract.
Foundry or Knowledge ships a question-addressable export that can replace a manual evidence link.
The first approved experiment returns an Observation Receipt and exposes a missing Library lineage field.
Three heterogeneous questions complete a full research-to-decision loop and justify stabilizing or deleting provisional fields.
source_scopes: the existing Frontier Question Works, metadata seeds, answer-lineage model, and question-driven research architecture
the generated Research index and individual Question Work reading surfaces
publication-safe Foundry, Knowledge, Evidence Engine, Event, ADR, Release, and Snapshot interfaces
privacy-safe receipts from real research, routing, repository, book, and implementation work
questions.answer_shape: A versioned God Questions operating architecture with a generated Observatory, machine-readable question-program contract, evidence and action-return interfaces, ownership boundaries, acceptance fixtures, and explicit promotion and kill gates.
questions.refresh_policy: Re-answer when a real question cannot use the contract, a source or action interface changes, three-question evaluation evidence lands, or measured operating overhead exceeds the value created.

action_learning_links.summary: GQ-009 defines the decision, falsifiers, evidence gaps, and expected answer without authorizing implementation.
The active initiative is represented as a bounded action candidate; approval and execution receipts remain separately owned.
Shaan approved a six-hour bounded infrastructure, verification, and closeout envelope; the private authorization payload remains owner-held and only its digest is public.
The mixed independent observation passed cold-reader and contract reconstruction but failed privacy hardening, producing a bounded repair requirement rather than an accepted answer.
The Learning Return proposes the privacy and temporal repairs now under verification while keeping GQ-009 researching, publishing no Answer Release, and promoting no capability.
